label: Nord Lead 2x ROM
description: NodalRed2x needs the firmware of your own Clavia Nord Lead 2x: a 512 kB flash dump (.bin).

rules.label: Nord Lead 2x flash ROM (512 kB)
rules.note: The right size for a Nord Lead 2x flash dump. NodalRed2x checks the firmware when it loads.

label: Nord Lead 2x sound sets
description: Optional: your own Nord Lead 2 / 2x sound sets as SysEx (.syx) or MIDI (.mid) single dumps, such as Clavia's Factory Program Library. Each file is a bank of up to 99 sounds.
hint: A .txt beside a bank with the same name (one name per line) names its sounds.

rules.label: MIDI file with SysEx dumps
rules.note: NodalRed2x uses the Nord Lead single dumps inside it; it checks them when it loads.

rules.label: Sound names
rules.note: One name per line, for the bank file with the same name.
